name: Sciophobia
source:
"I will follow you no matter how fast you run."

The night has come, and it comes for her. She yearns for help, but the only thing she finds is disbelief. Tonight the shadows lurk behind every dim light, and wherever she goes, the looming threat goes with her.

[From [url=https://fraudev-selzis.itch.io/sciophobia]Itch.io[/url]]
